properties.title: 3D Digital Twins for Temporary Roads: Leveraging CesiumJS and LandXML on WebGIS
properties.description:
Streamlining Construction Infrastructure with Web-Based 3D Digital Twins.
This solution empowers anyone to effortlessly plan and design LandXML-compliant temporary roads directly in a web browser. Leveraging CesiumJS and advanced 3D Tiles, it transforms complex civil engineering workflows into an intuitive, visual, and highly efficient experience.

We develop digital twin applications to improve efficiency in civil construction. This web-based solution empowers anyone to effortlessly plan and design temporary roads without requiring specialized expertise.

While complying with the LandXML international standard, the application features intuitive, hassle-free controls. Driven by advanced coordinate conversion and high-fidelity 3D rendering using CesiumJS and 3D Tiles, it delivers a seamless experience for creating and reviewing temporary roads directly in a web browser.
